title: Official Travel Advisory Comparator input
description: Look up one country or territory and compare its current official travel advisories from the U.S. Department of State, the U.K. FCDO and the Government of Canada.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: One country or territory, in English. Common alternate names and ISO 3166-1 codes are accepted, e.g. "Trinidad and Tobago", "Turkey" (resolves to Türkiye), "Ivory Coast", "TT". Ambiguous or unknown names return status "invalid_destination" and are not charged.

sources.title: Government sources
sources.description: Which official sources to compare. At least two are required. Default: all three.

includeRegional.title: Include regional warnings
includeRegional.description: Include the list of sub-national (regional) warnings that could be extracted from each source (availability varies by source). Regional maximum severity is always reported in normalizedSeverity.
